blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Sen. Bong Revilla asked the Sandiganbayan Third Division to dismiss his malversation case over an alleged ghost project in Bulacan worth over P92 million. The division’s clerk of court Dennis Pulma gave this information on Wednesday. Pulma told reporters that Revilla filed a motion for leave with an attached demurrer to evidence on Monday. An accused files a demurrer to evidence to dismiss a case immediately by asserting that the prosecution failed to present sufficient evidence to prove the case.
